narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

nina.instruct: Sweet, charming, indecisive young woman, bright and eager to please, fast.

kate.instruct: Hungry, impatient best friend at the end of her rope, fast and exasperated.

waitress.instruct: Calm, deadpan waitress with a sly smile, quick and matter of fact.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's minute forty, and your Libra friend still can't choose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Nina.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Charming, fair and allergic to conflict.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She loves everyone's ideas equally and that's the problem.

lines.speaker: kate
lines.text: Tacos or pizza Nina? Just pick one!

lines.speaker: nina
lines.text: I love both! What do you love?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She makes a pros and cons list with three columns.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She polls the group chat and it's a perfect tie.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Finally they find a place with no menu at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nina relaxes with no choices and no fights.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For the first time tonight she's winning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the waitress walks up with a tray.

lines.speaker: waitress
lines.text: Tonight, you pick. Chicken or fish?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The whole table freezes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's really going on inside a Libra?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a giant golden scale labelled DECISIONS with both sides always perfectly level.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to it a dial marked PLEASE EVERYONE is turned all the way up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a lucky coin with YES on both sides.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nina flips the coin and it lands on its edge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The waitress waits and the kitchen closes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nina goes home hungry and orders both with extra fries.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next week is her birthday and Kate asks where she wants to go.
